Hi, this looks good from a quick glance!

I have left some minor comments.

Regarding the test, I suggest you take a look at `TestSignInOauthCallbackSyncSSHKeys` (runnable locally with `make test-sqlite#TestSignInOauthCallbackSyncSSHKeys`), which calls `setupMockOIDCServer` to set the `.well-known/openid-configuration`
